subject: Request: one-off sandbox restart + conditional credits for Novalink POC
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novalink.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novalink.ai>
Date: 2028-06-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trial expired - request to restart sandbox for POC

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the engagement so far. We had some internal delays and our trial sandbox credits expired last week. The engineering team still needs a few more days to validate inference latency on our integration, and we'd like to restart the sandbox for a short window to finish the POC.

Can Redwood re-open the sandbox and provision a short-term credit (roughly $2k) so we can run a final evaluation? If needed, procurement can route a PO. We're hoping for a 1–2 week window.

Happy to jump on a quick call to align.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Director, Platform Engineering
Novalink

--
Attachments: none
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novalink.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@novalink.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired - request to restart sandbox for POC

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the note. We can do a one-off sandbox restart with a conditional credit to help you complete the POC. Proposed terms below: 

- Credit: $2,000 in platform credits applied to the Novalink sandbox account
- Window: 30 days from reactivation date (we generally do 14 days, but will extend to 30 for this POC)
- Usage cap: 500k generated tokens or equivalent $2k spend, whichever comes first
- Data: logs and usage telemetry enabled for the duration (privacy-safe)
- Approval: we need a signed mutual action plan (MAP) and either a PO or billing card on file before we enable the credits

If that works, I can attach the MAP and SOC2 summary for your procurement team, and Marissa (CS) will set a short kickoff. Please confirm who from your side will sign the MAP and provide a billing contact/PO number.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I'll attach the MAP and SOC2 summary to this thread.
2) Procurement confirms PO or billing card and returns a signed MAP.
3) We re-enable sandbox and apply credit within 24 hours of receiving the MAP + PO/card.

Let me know if you want to swap the 30 days for 14; we can be flexible but need visibility on expected token volumes.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0118

--
Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v2.docx (docx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novalink.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired - request to restart sandbox for POC

Looping in briefly to approve a one-off credit for Novalink. Soojin — thanks for the proposed terms; I support the 30-day window with the $2k cap. A couple clarifications before we move forward: 

- Please apply the credit as a one-time top-up to their sandbox account rather than retroactive billing.
- Require SOC2 summary before enabling (SaaS risk team asked for a short doc).
- If usage exceeds the cap, we'll notify Novalink and provide an overage estimate before charging.

Marissa — can you schedule a 30-minute onboarding/kickoff once procurement confirms?

Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

--
Note: final approval contingent on procurement acceptance and MAP signature.
From: Procurement <procurement@novalink.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired - request to restart sandbox for POC

Hi Soojin / team,

Novalink procurement is OK with the 30-day restart and $2k conditional credit on the following notes: 
- We will issue PO #1234 covering the trial restart. PO will be uploaded to this thread by EOD.
- We need a short invoice/DocuSign envelope for the MAP so our legal team can sign.
- Please confirm who will be the billing contact for any potential overage before the cap is reached. Our billing contact is: Billing Ops <billing@novalink.ai>.

Once we have the MAP envelope, we will countersign and send the PO. Please attach SOC2 summary and the MAP for review (if Soojin already sent them, we will check).

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Novalink

--
Attachments: Novalink-PO-1234.pdf (pdf, stub)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <procurement@novalink.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@novalink.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T17:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial expired - request to restart sandbox for POC

Fantastic — thanks Lydia and Alex. 

I've attached the MAP (mutual-action-plan-v2.docx) and a one-page SOC2 summary (SOC2-summary.pdf) to this reply and started a DocuSign envelope here: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0A1B2C3D4E. 

Next steps from our side:
- Once I see the signed MAP or the uploaded PO (#1234), I'll trigger the sandbox restart and apply the $2k credit (expected within 24 hours).
- Marissa will send a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff to review test cases and expected token volumes.
- I'll add Billing Ops <billing@novalink.ai> to the notification list so we can notify them if usage reaches 80% of the cap.

If you want a 14-day window instead of 30, tell me now — otherwise I'll proceed with 30 days.

Thanks all — looking forward to finishing the POC.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
